extracted.name: Rum old-fashioned
extracted.description: Try using rum in place of whisky in an old-fashioned for a twist on the traditional cocktail. Finish with ice and a strip of orange peel
ingredient_lines: strip of orange peel to garnish
instruction_lines: Put half the rum, the sugar syrup and bitters in a mixing glass or jug. Add three ice cubes and stir slowly with a mixing spoon until the outside of the glass feels cold. Add the rest of the rum and a few more ice cubes, then stir to just combine.
Strain the drink into an ice-filled rocks glass or tumbler and garnish with the strip of orange peel.
